full_prompt_en: A square expressionist black-and-white portrait shows a middle-aged man in a dark brimmed hat against a nearly featureless black background. His head occupies the center and right of the frame, turned slightly toward the left while his pale eyes look past the camera. The hat brim drops diagonally from the upper left across the forehead, leaving a hard shadow above the brows. A white highlight catches the near side of the brim, but the crown disappears into surrounding darkness. Sharp light carves the forehead, both eyes, the projecting nose, taut mouth, cheekbone, and long angular jaw. A deep black wedge beside the nose and under the eye interrupts the pale facial plane, heightening the uneasy expression. The far ear remains visible at the right edge, with its inner curve picked out by a thin glint. Below the face, a white shirt collar opens over a thick patterned dark cravat or scarf, and the black jacket merges with the backdrop. Fine film grain and slight softness in the shadows give the image a vintage photographic surface. The left half of the frame remains mostly black, offering little context beyond a faint gradation near the bottom. The pose is still, and the close viewpoint allows wrinkles around the eyes and changes in skin tone to carry the drama. A strong, narrow source from the viewer's left and above makes the facial highlights almost white, while the opposite side falls away into darkness. The overall composition is austere and psychologically charged, balancing a sculpted light face against a large dark void.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义黑白肖像呈现一位戴深色宽檐帽的中年男子，背景几乎全黑，没有明显细节。他的头占据中央与右侧，略向左转，浅色双眼望过镜头。帽檐从左上斜落，跨过额头，在眉上留下硬阴影。帽檐近侧接住一条白亮边，帽冠则消失在周围黑暗中。锐利光线刻出额头、双眼、突出的鼻子、紧闭的嘴、颧骨及修长带棱角的下颌。鼻旁与眼下的一道深黑楔形切开浅色面部平面，增强不安的神情。较远一侧耳朵仍在右边缘可见，内侧弧线被一道细光挑亮。脸部下方，白衬衫领在厚实花纹的深色领巾或围巾上方敞开，黑外套融入背景。细胶片颗粒和阴影中的些许柔化使图像有老照片表面。左半画幅大多是黑色，除底部一点微弱渐变外几乎没有环境线索。姿态静止，近距离视点使眼周皱纹和肤色变化承担戏剧性。来自观者左上方的强而窄的光让面部亮处近白，对侧则迅速陷入黑暗。整体构图简峻且富于心理张力，以被光雕刻的面孔平衡宽大暗域。
style_prompt_en: The image has a vintage expressionist photographic finish, built on deep black voids and sharply carved pale planes. A diagonal dark edge cuts across the upper field, while concentrated highlights expose a few angular forms and leave adjoining surfaces unresolved. Skinlike midtones and visible grain preserve physical detail inside the high contrast. Contours are hard where illumination strikes directly and fade at the shadow boundary, making depth feel abrupt and theatrical. A narrow light from one upper side generates stark ridges and heavy opposite shade. Open dark space balances the dense focal area rather than filling the frame with detail. The overall effect is severe, spare, and psychologically intense.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有复古表现主义摄影完成感，由深黑空域与被锐光雕出的浅色平面构成。一道斜向暗边切过上方区域，集中的亮部揭示少数棱角形体，相邻表面则保持不明确。带肤理的中间调和可见颗粒在高反差中保留实体细节。直受光处边缘坚硬，进入暗部时逐渐消失，使纵深突然且带戏剧性。来自一侧上方的狭窄光形成鲜明凸线和对面厚重阴影。开阔暗域平衡密集焦点，而不以细节填满画框。整体效果严峻、简练且心理张力强。
theme_en: A severe black-and-white close portrait of a man beneath a dark brimmed hat
theme_zh: 深色帽檐下男子的冷峻黑白近景肖像
name: Fritz Lang
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
